{{Quote|Well, the bounty hunter we ran into on Ord Mantell changed my mind.|Han Solo|<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
'''Ord Mantell''' was a [[planet]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] that served as the capital of the [[Bright Jewel system]]. It was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Mantellian Savrip]] [[species]]. Ord Mantell was colonized around [[12,000 BBY]] by [[Corellian]] settlers during the expansion of the [[Galactic Republic]], where it became an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot]] outpost. In the waning [[Standard day|days]] of the Republic, [[Ord Mantell City]] housed a base of operations for the [[Black Sun]] crime syndicate. It later came under control of the [[Galactic Empire]] and became home to an Imperial [[deepdock]].

==Description==
[[File:OrdMantellCity.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ord Mantell City]]
Ord Mantell was the terrestrial capital [[planet]] of the [[Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="BMF 48" /> at grid square L-7 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="TFABG" /> and was the second planet to [[orbit]] the [[Color|blue]] [[star]] [[Bright Jewel]]. Orbited by at least fifteen [[moon]]s,<ref name="BMF 48" /> including the moon of [[Quantxi]],<ref name="Life Debt" /> Ord Mantell was 14,050 [[kilometer]]s in diameter and served as the [[sector]] [[capital]] for the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim's]] [[Bright Jewel sector]], which in turn was the capital for the [[Bright Jewel Oversector]].<ref name="BMF 48" /> In close proximity to the [[gas giant]] [[Wynkahthu]],<ref name="Wynkahthu">{{Databank|wynkahthu|Wynkahthu}}</ref> Ord Mantell was situated in the northern [[New Territories]] portion of the Mid Rim, lying on a cross-section between the Bright Jewel, [[Qiilura sector|Qiilura]] and [[Dohu sector]]s along the [[Celanon Spur]],<ref name="BMF 48" /> [[Burke's Trailing]]<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" /> and [[Entralla Route|Entralla]] [[hyperspace route]]s.<ref name="BMF 48" /> The Burke's Trailing [[hyperspace]] route connected the planet to the moon of [[Jedha]] in the nearby [[Terrabe sector]].<ref name="Smuggler's Guide" />

A planet of [[Temperature|temperate]] climate, Ord Mantell maintained a breathable Type I [[atmosphere]] and standard [[gravity]], and it presented a pinkish hue when viewed from [[Realspace|space]] as a result of its thick clouds, which littered its skies. On the surface, every landmass on Ord Mantell was dotted with [[mountain]] chains, but its population of four billion lived on its arid equatorial continents amid the foothills of its mountains and plains. Ord Mantell was home to many different species, with no single one representing more than five percent of the planet's population.<ref name="BMF 48" />

==History==
===Colonization of Ord Mantell===
Around [[12,000 BBY]], the planet Ord Mantell was colonized by settlers from the [[Core Worlds|Core World]] planet [[Corellia]] during the middle era of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s expansion, in which it became one of many [[Ordnance/Regional Depot]] outposts. At the time, Ord Mantell was isolated in what was known as the [[Wild Space]] of the northern quadrant, and was only accessible through an intricate network of frontier hyperspace routes. As the Republic grew in territory size, the planet's strategic significance was lost, but civilian cargo trade began to grow due to the presence of a military-grade [[shipyard]] and drydocks.<ref name="BMF 48" />

After [[3700 BBY]], Ord Mantell became notable as a trading post for [[spacer]]s who traveled west of the [[Hydian Way]] [[super-hyperroute]]. As the population grew, an increasing percentage of the arriving settlers began to include less savory visitors, such as tax evaders, [[smuggler]]s, and those working on the [[black market]]. The lawless and adventurous spirit of such groups, combined with the [[Corellian]]s' independent nature, served to create a culture of criminal activity that lasted on Ord Mantell thereafter.<ref name="BMF 48" />

Sometime before the [[First Battle of Geonosis|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Republic attempted to create several other trade hubs across the galaxy, in hopes of rivaling Ord Mantell's success as a trading port. However, the Republic was unable to create a world that could compete with its success, despite Ord Mantell's reputation as a criminal [[shadowport]].<ref name="BMF 48" />

===Republic Era===
During the tenure of [[Finis Valorum]] as [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, the [[Quaraxian]] [[thief]] [[Phaedra]] [[Robbery of the Galactic Bank of Coruscant|robbed]] [[Galactic Senate|Galactic Senator]] [[Beka]]'s account from the [[Galactic Bank of Coruscant|Bank of Coruscant]]. After faking her [[death]] on [[Nar Shaddaa]], Phaedra hid out on Ord Mantell but was quickly discovered by [[Jedi Knight]]s [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Shaak Ti]], who turned her over to [[Marshal]] [[Buck Vancto]] of the [[Benelex Marshal Service]].<ref name="Jedi Knights 4">[[Jedi Knights 4|''Jedi Knights'' 4]]</ref>

In [[23 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] took a [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Jango Fett)|job]] with fellow hunters [[Needla]], [[Rinn (Gand)|Rinn]], and [[Tiver]], also bringing along his son [[Boba Fett|Boba]] to teach him about working with new people. Together, they traveled to Ord Mantell and staked out a cantina, eventually cornering their target, a [[Unidentified Twi'lek (Ord Mantell)|Twi'lek woman]] who was the daughter of their client, on a balcony. After capturing her, Rinn and Tiver betrayed the others, with Tiver drawing his [[sword]]s and taking Boba hostage, although the young hunter ended up killing both Tiver and Rinn.<ref name="Jango 1">[[Age of Republic - Jango Fett 1|''Age of Republic - Jango Fett'' 1]]</ref>

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Lead your fleet to Ord Mantell. Your allies—Black Sun—have a stronghold there.|[[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Talzin]], to [[Maul]]|<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" />}}
[[File:Tear-Them-Apart.png|thumb|right|270px|The Shadow Collective and Confederacy of Independent Systems battled on Ord Mantell.]]
By the time of the Clone Wars, Ord Mantell became home to a large base for the [[Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Nevertheless, in the years following the Battle of Geonosis, the planet housed a [[Ord Mantell storage facility|storage facility]], [[Ord Mantell barracks|barracks]], and [[Ord Mantell fleet support base|fleet support base]] for the Republic's [[Grand Army of the Republic|Grand Army]] and [[Republic Navy|Navy]]. Additionally, Ord Mantell served as the headquarters for the Republic's [[8th Sector Army]]. All of this served to define Ord Mantell as an important planet for the Republic,<ref name="BMF 48" /> much to the annoyance of the Black Sun.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Kashyyyk and Other Planets in the Mid Rim}}</ref>

Black Sun would go onto join the rogue [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]]'s [[Shadow Collective]] on the hope that it would give them the power needed to reclaim Ord Mantell.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In the waning [[Standard day|days]] of the Republic,<ref name="Ord Mantell">{{Databank|ord-mantell|Ord Mantell}}</ref> a [[Battle on Ord Mantell|battle]] was fought on the planet between the Shadow Collective and the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" /> The assault was launched by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]],<ref name="BMF 48" /> [[Count]] [[Dooku]], and [[General]] [[Grievous]] as part of their [[campaign against the Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" />

During the war, the [[Trandoshan]] [[Information broker|informant]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]] worked with the [[Jedi Order]] while based on Ord Mantell. The [[clone trooper]] [[Echo]] was aware of such activities but was not aware of Cid's identity, only knowing her by name.<ref name="Rampage" />

===Imperial Era===
During the early days of the [[Galactic Empire]], the rogue [[Clone Force 99]], which Echo had joined, traveled to Ord Mantell to locate Cid, hoping she would be able to help them. They were able to locate [[Cid's Parlor]] and with the shrewd observation of the young [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]], learned that Cid was the Trandoshan that owned the establishment. The clones would agree to undertake a mission for Cid in exchange for information, traveling to the ruins of [[Old Ord Mantell City]] to [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Clone Force 99)|rescue]] [[Muchi]], who was being held captive by [[Zygerrian]] [[enslaver]]s operating there at that time.<ref name="Rampage" /> Clone Force 99 would continue to be based out of Ord Mantell as they worked several missions for Cid<ref name="Decommissioned">{{TBB|Decommissioned}}</ref><ref name="Spoils">{{TBB|Spoils of War}}</ref> until Imperial forces<ref name="Plan 99">{{TBB|Plan 99 (episode)}}</ref> [[Occupation of Ord Mantell|assumed control of Ord Mantell]]<ref name="AC Databank">{{Databank|at-ac-walker|AT-AC walker}}</ref> upon being alerted to the Bad Batch's location by Cid.<ref name="Plan 99" />

In the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the Empire, the Bright Jewel sector became the capital of the Bright Jewel [[Oversector]], which also housed the [[Yavin system]] located in the [[Gordian Reach]].<ref name="BMF 48" /> Hyperspace lanes in the sector were of interest to the Empire, with [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Major]] [[Lio Partagaz]] tasking [[ISB Supervisor|Supervisor]] [[Lonni Jung]] with making a full audit on each of the lanes leading to Ord Mantell.<ref name="Announcement">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> Following the [[Battle of Yavin|destruction]] of the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] at [[Yavin]], the Empire attempted to increase its control in the sector,<ref name="BMF 48" /> eventually coming to establish a [[deepdock]],<ref name="Tarkin" /> but Ord Mantell still managed to maintain neutrality during the [[Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BMF 48" />

At one point, [[Crimson Dawn]] leader [[Qi'ra]], the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]], and the bounty hunter [[IG-88B|IG-88]] hunted each other down on Ord Mantell, with the latter two partnering with each other to capture Qi'ra. The pair succeeded in capturing the woman, but when Ohnaka accidentally revealed that the bounty on his head was worth more, IG-88 turned on the [[Weequay]]. Following a brief scrap, IG-88 was handcuffed by Ohnaka, but after Qi'ra managed to free herself, she then captured Ohanka as well.<ref name="Trips">{{FOD|Triplecross}}</ref> The [[Devaronian]] pirate [[Melos]] was hunted down by three bounty hunters—[[Viktor Hel]], [[Koshka Frost]], and "[[Doctor]]" [[Krandak]]—on Ord Mantell.<ref name="NoDisintegrations">[[No Disintegrations (Fantasy Flight Games)|''No Disintegrations'']]</ref>

Beyond the Empire's early deployment of troops and walkers to Ord Mantell during the hunt for Clone Force 99,<ref name="Plan 99" /> the Empire began to blackmail and bribe the [[Ord Mantell government|ruling government]] to absolve fears that the planet's lawlessness would encourage [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] activity. They monitored the world by staging nearby fleet maneuvers nearby instead of attempting total Imperial subjugation. However, as the Empire built up its ground forces, the Mantellians began to see more and more Imperial [[stormtrooper]]s appear around their [[City|cities]].<ref name="BMF 48" /> Amid the civil war, prior to the [[Battle of Hoth]], Rebel Alliance member and former smuggler Han Solo had a run-in<ref name="Episode V" /> with bounty hunter [[Skorr]]<ref name="Whills Strike Back">{{StoryCite|story=The Whills Strike Back|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}}</ref> on Ord Mantell's surface.<ref name="Ord Mantell">{{Databank|ord-mantell|Ord Mantell}}</ref>

At one point, the [[Gran]] criminal [[Heelt]] stole a rare [[silvercore speeder]] from the Black Sun boss [[Lord]] [[Gyuti]] and attempted to sell it in Ord Mantell City. A [[Boushh's crew|crew]] led by [[Boushh]], who were working for Gyuti, were able to recover and return the speeder following a brief shootout.<ref name="Boushh">[[War of the Bounty Hunters – Boushh 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters – Boushh'' 1]]</ref> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="OutlawsDate">{{OutlawsDate}}</ref> a [[shuttle]] departed for Ord Mantell from transport bay four at [[Kijimi Spaceport|the spaceport]] on [[Kijimi]].<ref name="Outlaws">''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]''</ref>

==Inhabitants==
===Species===
After its colonization, Ord Mantell became the [[homeworld]] of a variety of different [[species]]—commonly referred to as Mantellians—and no particular species on Ord Mantell represented more than five percent of its total population.<ref name="BMF 48" /> The planet was also home to the [[Mantellian Savrip]], a species whose appearance was used for a [[Hologram|holographic]] piece in the game of [[dejarik]]. It was also inhabited by [[Bith]],<ref name="Absolutely Everything You Need to Know" /> [[Falleen]], and [[human]]s.<ref name="Galactic Atlas" />

===Government===
{{Main|Ord Mantell government}}
Ord Mantell was ruled by a planetary government of which was led by several [[governor]]s. The planet's governors and representatives were no strangers to Ord Mantell's illicit activities that happened frequently across the planet, and were known to accept bribes or turn a blind eye to them. The [[Mantellian courts]] also respected the rights of bounty hunters, viewing them as a free-market approach to [[Law enforcement agency|law enforcement]] on the planet.<ref name="BMF 48" />

===Entertainment===
As a result of the planet's lawlessness, Ord Mantell helped in the rise of a thriving gambling and entertainment industry. Along the [[Worlport]] continent's southern coast, a series of cities provided the necessary services for gambling and other games. The cities were modern and billions of tourists who traveled from the Core could expect to find any luxury to which they were accustomed in their home region. Of the planet's casinos, the most popular was [[Lady Fate Casino]]; however, more professional gamblers were found in the side streets and alley casinos such as the Chance Cube, [[Throw Me a Bone]], or Lucky Detooa's in the city of [[Savroia]]. Several of the casinos had the highest payouts along the Celanon Spur.<ref name="BMF 48" />

==Locations==
Ord Mantell's surface was home to several cities, such as the capital city of Worlport,<ref name="BMF 48" /> [[Ord Mantell City]],<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" /> [[Freelonn]], and Savroia, all of which were known for their fringe activities. The planet's open markets sold nearly everything, and nothing was ever truly illegal on Ord Mantell. Its coastal cities, including Worlport, seduced visitors into spending their credits at the casinos' gambling tables. Cities on the planet's outskirts were much less developed, littered with outstretched junkyards, mountains, and [[mine]]s. Small [[fishing]] communities existed along the continental shores, which preferred not to interact with outlanders.<ref name="BMF 48" />
